The '''Santhe/Sienar Technologies Corporate Headquarters''' was located in [[Lianna City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It was the headquarters for [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]], [[Curich Engineering]], [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]], and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

Occupying the complex's fifty-seventh floor was Sienar Fleet Systems' laboratories. A restricted area only acceesible through Lift 2, the laboratories handled all of the special military projects for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Security material from the lab was often transferred to the private database on floor 43 to be assembled in its entirety.
